text: {"assertions":["On 2026-03-08, a bug was found in analytics/dashboards/funnel.py where the funnel report was missing a step in the pipeline.","The missing step bug manifested as a stage with zero users appearing between two populated stages in the funnel.","The root cause was two database writes that were not wrapped in a transaction, causing inconsistent state.","The bug was only reproduced on the staging read replica.","The fix involved wrapping both writes in a single transaction and was submitted as PR #3355 on branch fix/missing-step-1.","The bug can be reproduced by building the funnel for a two-week window.","The covering test for this issue is in tests/analytics/test_funnel.py.","After the fix, cold start performance improved by 8 percent, dropping from approximately 307ms to 283ms."]}
